Class LeadService

public without sharing class LeadService

Service class for Lead-related business operations. Provides functionality to archive Lead records by copying them to LeadArchive__c custom object using the FieldReplicationService and then deleting the original Lead records. Handles bulk operations with partial success support and comprehensive error logging.

Methods

public static List<Database.SaveResult> archive(Set<Id> recordIds)

Archives Lead records by copying them to LeadArchive__c and deleting the originals. Uses partial success mode for both insert and delete operations, logging any failures to ErrorLog__c. Only deletes Lead records that were successfully archived.

Parameters:
    recordIds – Set<Id>: Set of Lead record IDs to archive

Returns:
    Database.SaveResult[]: Array of save results from the LeadArchive__c insert operation
